description: This PHP class defines a plugin for generating detailed conversion tracking reports within the Revive Adserver platform. It includes methods for initializing report info, retrieving default settings, executing report generation, and creating various worksheets such as performance, connection summary, variable summaries, and connection details. It also handles data fetching, processing, and formatting for report output.

classes.name: Plugins_Reports_OxReportsStandard_ConversionTrackingReport
classes.description: A plugin class for generating comprehensive conversion tracking reports, including performance, connection summaries, variable summaries, and detailed connection data within the Revive Adserver platform.

methods.name: initInfo
methods.description: Initializes report metadata such as name, description, category, author, export format, and authorizations.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves default report parameters based on user session preferences for report period, scope, and worksheets.

methods.name: saveDefaults
methods.description: Saves user-selected report parameters into session preferences for future use.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to generate the report, preparing data and creating worksheets based on selected sheets.

methods.name: _checkParameters
methods.description: Validates that at least one report sheet is selected before proceeding.

methods.name: _getReportParametersForDisplay
methods.description: Returns displayable report parameters such as date range and scope.

methods.name: _addPerformanceByDayWorksheet
methods.description: Creates the 'Performance by Day' worksheet using statistics controller data.

methods.name: _addConnectionByDayWorksheet
methods.description: Creates the 'Connection Summary by Day' worksheet with connection status data per tracker.

methods.name: _addVariableByDayWorksheet
methods.description: Creates the 'Variable Summary by Day' worksheet with conversion and variable data.

methods.name: _addVariableByVariableWorksheet
methods.description: Creates the 'Variable Summary by Variable' worksheet showing variable breakdowns.

methods.name: _addConnectionDetailWorksheet
methods.description: Creates the 'Connection Detail' worksheet with detailed connection records.

methods.name: _prepareConnections
methods.description: Fetches and structures connection and conversion data from the database within the specified date range and scope.

methods.name: _prepareTrackerVariables
methods.description: Retrieves tracker variable metadata for the connections in the report.

methods.name: _prepareConnectionsWindowDelay
methods.description: Calculates and adds window delay times for each connection.

methods.name: _isTrackerLinkedToAnonymousCampaign
methods.description: Checks if a tracker is associated with an anonymous campaign.

methods.name: _shouldDisplaySourceField
methods.description: Determines if the source field should be shown based on user permissions.

methods.name: _decodeConnectionType
methods.description: Translates connection type codes into human-readable strings.

methods.name: _getConnectionStatuses
methods.description: Returns a list of connection statuses with their labels.

methods.name: _decodeConnectionStatus
methods.description: Translates a connection status code into a human-readable string.
